home: House of the Mountain of Fire, Dravesa
appearance: Early 30s, lean, friendly. Always slightly warm to the touch.
and_yet: Eyes linger on you half a second longer than they should.
wants: Rakhmoth's arrival; formal recognition for the Schismatics.
oddly_also: Perfect recall of every conversation he has ever had.
family: His family disowned him when he joined the Schismatics; a young son, Dav, being raised by his mother across town.
recreation: Correspondence with pilgrims at the Mountain of Fire.
dreams: Rakhmoth's theology formally recognized before the Orthodox dies out on its own.
anecdotes: Quoted a man's own words back to him from three years prior, verbatim, mid-argument.
tragedies: Dav doesn't know who his father is.
pc_leverage: Will cooperate fully with any inquiry and leave nothing findable. Tell: ask if Jorun's pilgrimage was a good thing — he'll say yes and show no doubt.
